name: penthera
description: Open-source security for the apps and AI systems you ship. Before you deploy: scan your app and repo, fix on a local branch and verify. What you build with: vet npm dependencies, guard installs, audit skills, MCP servers and hooks. After you ship: reports, evidence bundles, NIS2 and CRA readiness. Offline, deterministic, no telemetry. Authorized testing only.
